about.description: Street Art Dispatch is the urban art and culture publication. We follow artists working beyond conventional gallery spaces.

settings.heading: About and standards
settings.stand: Street Art Dispatch is the urban art and culture publication. We follow artists working beyond conventional gallery spaces.
intro: We cover public interventions, urban installations, experimental materials and the collectable works that come out of them.

We write for three kinds of reader: culturally curious people who meet street art on their phones, collectors from first-time buyers to established ones, and the trade, meaning galleries, curators, press and auction specialists.
We explain, give context and take a view. We do not deal in hype, and we do not glamorise damage to property.
We document things as well as comment on them. The Intervention Archive is a dated, searchable record of art made in public.
We launch around Konn Artiss and are expanding across the artists shown by Grove Gallery. Any gallery relationship is disclosed on the page.

items.text: Every factual claim about a living artist is confirmed with the artist, their studio or their gallery before publication. Auction figures are cited with sale, date and whether they include buyer’s premium.
Where Street Art Dispatch has a commercial relationship with a gallery, for example Grove Gallery, it is stated on every page that features that gallery’s artists.
We commission or license every image and credit it. Photographs of public works still carry a photographer credit.
We document unsanctioned work as cultural history. We don’t encourage criminal damage or the removal of public works.
We never invent quotes. Quotes from artists come from interviews or attributable published sources.
Corrections are dated and shown at the foot of the article.

settings.end_text: Pitches, tips, press and corrections go to info@artiscope.co.uk. More ways to reach us are on the contact page.
